scenes.title: The letter
scenes.narration: A letter came from my mother! Read it quietly, then help me answer some questions.
scenes.subject: english

items.narration: Why must Tumi take the hill path?
focus: text:Dear Tumi, The rains came early this year. The river rose so high that the old bridge is under water, so please take the hill path instead. Mma Dineo told me you were a great help at the market; I was proud, but not surprised. Bring the oranges if any are left! Your little brother has learned to whistle and will not stop. Come home before dark. Love, Mama.
options: Mama said the market is closed
items.note: Taps The bridge is under water
items.subject: english

scenes.title: Home at last
scenes.narration: There's my house, and there's Mama, and there's my brother, whistling! You brought me all the way home. Thank you.
